AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.

2. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

3. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.

4. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.

5. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

7. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

10. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.

11. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Navigation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Terminal Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
